reports.en: Egyptian military spokesman: the Chief of Staff of the South Region Border Guard and Chief of Battalion Operations were killed during the response to illegal gold mining

reports.en: The Egyptian Army: all strikes in the campaign against illegal gold mining have been carried out within our borders.
